title: MicroSim Template
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Explain how the animated circles moving around the square wire loop represent electron flow as electric current
Predict how raising the speed slider from 0.02 to 0.5 changes the rate at which electrons traverse the circuit
Distinguish the effect of the spacing slider, which sets electron density along the wire, from the speed slider, which sets drift rate
Relate electron drift speed and spacing to the amount of current carried by a conductor
Trace how animationTime advances only while the simulation is running, so that Start and Pause leave the electrons visible in place
